issues: React hydration console warning: <span> injected inside <option> — caused by emergent visual-editor instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic wrapper spans on {s.session_id}), not user code. Functionally harmless but produces console noise in dev.

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsDialog PUT sends red_alert_threshold/danger_threshold/auto_handoff/features every save even if unchanged — fine, but note red/danger inputs allow arbitrary integers (no min/max validation client-side; backend also does not validate 1-99 for those two). Consider matching alert_thresholds validation.
CompareView allows selecting the same session in both dropdowns (A=B) — the 'better' highlight then falls through to white (handled), but UX-wise disabling identical selection would be cleaner.
playChime uses new AudioContext() unconditionally which may violate browser autoplay policy (no user-gesture check for very first chime). Wrapped in try/catch so silent-fail is graceful.
